tools.name: list_components
tools.description: List Spark UI components (names + summaries). Use to browse what exists; use search_components to find by keyword/intent, then get_component for full details.

query.description: Optional keyword filter (component name or description).

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Get a Spark UI component: its import, props, composition requirements (required provider/ancestors/parts) where applicable, and one canonical wired example. Pass include="examples" for the full example set, or include="all" for examples plus recommended token families.

include.description: Optional CSV of extra detail: "examples", "tokens", or "all". Defaults to a lean response.

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Search components by name, description, prop names, or intent aliases (e.g. "info banner" → Callout, "side panel" → Drawer/Sheet). Returns summaries; drill in with get_component.

query.description: Search term — keyword or intent phrase (e.g. "info banner").

tools.name: list_tokens
tools.description: Browse the Spark `--spark-*` theming tokens. With NO arguments, returns the category index (groups: accent, accent-alpha, semantic, radius, style, sizing, component) with counts — cheap, no token dump. Pass group= to drill into one category (e.g. group="semantic"), or use search_tokens / get_token to narrow. Tokens are the runtime output of the theming knobs; the shown values are the default theme. Palette groups vary by theme (light/dark); knob/component groups are largely global.

query.description: Optional keyword filter; when set, returns matching tokens instead of the category index.

theme.description: Optional theme filter (light/dark/global). Applies mainly to the accent/semantic color groups.

group.description: Category to drill into: accent, accent-alpha, semantic, radius, style, sizing, or component.

tools.name: get_token
tools.description: Resolve one `--spark-*` token by exact name (e.g. --spark-9, --spark-surface, --spark-rounded-lg) to its value(s) across light/dark/global themes.

tools.name: search_tokens
tools.description: Find Spark theming tokens by name or value (e.g. "surface", "rounded", "contrast", "a9"). Use when you know what you want; call list_tokens with no args to browse categories first.

query.description: Search term — token name or value (e.g. "surface").

tools.name: list_guidelines
tools.description: List Spark guidelines and recipes — theming (tokens, knobs, cascade, dark mode), composition, custom-block patterns (the SDK handshake, entities, dialogs, localization, toasts), and the Spark skill. Returns an index; use get_guideline for the full text.

query.description: Optional filter for guideline slug, title, or headings.

tools.name: get_guideline
tools.description: Get the full text of a Spark guideline or recipe by slug (e.g. sdk/theming, sdk/getting-started, sdk/entities, skills).
